curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8259-1-1.pdf and 8259-1-2.pdf (the bulldozer); 8259-1-3.pdf builds the alternate model

functions.does: Turning the knob at the back (a bush on the long axle through the body) turns the worm under the seat, which turns the 8 tooth gear on the lift arms' axle: the arms swing and the blade rises and lowers.
functions.source: book: 1 steps 8-12 (the long axle and its joiner); 2 steps 22 (worm and lift arms), 24 (arrow: the arms swing up) and 28 (knob at the back); inferred: the book draws no arrow for the knob

functions.does: The two tracks roll as the bulldozer is pushed along; nothing drives them. Each track runs round a 16 tooth gear at each end of its side, so its two gears turn together: p75 with p46 on one side, p74 with p55 on the other.
functions.source: book: 2 steps 29 (front gears) and 30 (tracks, 26 links each)
functions.note: each control should turn the other gear on its own side (p75 turns p46, p74 turns p55) and not the far side's

functions.does: The two yellow rams standing on the blade are only for show: each is an axle in an axle joiner, fixed to the blade's side.
